about.title: Apple Valley Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Eleven people died in traffic collisions in Apple Valley during 2025, according to public records. Behind each of those numbers is a parent, a partner, or a child, and the families left behind in this High Desert town of roughly 72,000 now face questions no one wants to ask. A wrongful death claim is one way California law lets survivors seek accountability when someone else's carelessness takes a life, whether that happened on Bear Valley Road, along Route 18, near Kiowa Road, or in a hospital or workplace far from any street. It is a civil matter, entirely separate from anything the San Bernardino County District Attorney may pursue. Standing is limited: a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window is shorter when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Apple Valley families, free of charge, with an independent attorney who works on contingency.

whyChoose.title: What Apple Valley Families Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Who Can Bring the Claim
items.desc: California gives first standing to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and the decedent's children. If none exist, certain financially dependent relatives and heirs may step in, and an attorney can sort out who qualifies in your family.

items.title: A Two-Year Clock, Sometimes Shorter
items.desc: The general deadline is two years from the date of death. When a city, county, or state agency may share fault, a formal claim must usually be presented much sooner, so early guidance matters.

items.title: What Losses Can Be Recovered
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. None of it replaces a person, but the law recognizes each of these harms.

items.question: The driver who caused the crash on Bear Valley Road is facing criminal charges. Do we still need a civil case?
items.answer: Yes, the two proceed independently. A criminal case in San Bernardino County is brought by prosecutors to punish the defendant, not to compensate your family. A wrongful death claim is your own civil action, and it can move forward whether or not charges are filed or a conviction results.

items.question: My father wasn't married and I'm his only adult child. Can I file?
items.answer: In most situations, yes. California places children among the first in line to bring a wrongful death claim when there is no surviving spouse or domestic partner. An attorney will confirm your standing and check whether anyone else must be included.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect us with an attorney?
items.answer: No. Our service is free, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, which means there is no fee unless your family receives a recovery.
